Service provided in Flower Mound, TX.

I highly recommend Cote's for HVAC needs. I have used them for over 10 years, and have always been happy with the service provided. The best thing about Cote's is that they are accommodating by sending a dedicated technician every visit ( originally it was Robert, then Houston and now Albert C.). This builds a good rapport and gives me consistently stellar service which I truly appreciate! The company was taken over by a larger firm, and I feared that I'd l

I noticed my heater wouldn’t come on when it got cold in the house. I called Cite’s and they got out that day. We had to order a part to fix the issue and the next day they returned to put in the new part. Jacob Morris was my technician and was very courteous and prompt. Thank you so much for caring about my comfort and getting me some heat as quickly as you could.

I had a great experience with Cotes for HVAC Replacement. The tech they sent out, Houston, came by when we were having problems with our current unit and encouraged us to replace our 14 year-old system. He was very knowledgeable and professional, so we ultimately went with Cotes over other quotes we had received. It did take awhile to get the city by to inspect the unit after install, but the answering service was very helpful in getting everything scheduled. Cotes did have to come back out to r

I had my A/C go out they were able to get someone out the next day to take a look. They called and told me they had someone call out so they reached out to a sister company to give us the bid. Manny gave us the bid and he stayed in contact answering any questions I had about the system, what was in the estimate, etc. Tony Palacios and Jose Cardoza are the techs that came to install, they made sure they worked clean, they had drops throughout the house where they would work, and made sure to capt

Toby Hernandez was amazing, he was very thorough, he was extremely knowledgeable with HVAC and had answers and suggestions to all my questions. By far the best mechanic that has ever been out here. I would have to give Toby an A+++, and I have requested him for all my future work here.

We had the pleasure of working with Dylan for our AC service, and I couldn’t be more impressed. From the moment he arrived, he was professional, courteous, and respectful of our home. He took the time to carefully explain the issue with our unit in a way that was easy to understand, and he walked us through the options without ever making us feel pressured.

Dylan’s attention to detail and knowledge were clear right away. He worked efficiently, but never rushed, and made sure everything was runn

Super fast and prompt service. Booked on line and a fantastic technician named Cody was out the next day. He was thorough, polite, helpful and went above and beyond to help me out not only with my AC but also with a minor plumbing issue. Would definitely recommend.

Zach M. was fantastic! He arrived promptly within the time window that was communicated when the service was scheduled. He took time to explain different functions and issues we were experiencing with our A/C unit. Within a short time we began to feel cool air once again. He went out of his way to reset and configure my smart thermostat and then did a home walkthrough with his temperature reading laser tool. He shared several recommendations that we have added to our home rehab list and we signe

Cote’s was referred to me, and now I see why.
Jacob Morris exceeded my expectations!
His knowledge, professionalism and a thorough assessment of my unit was given with clear concise communication.
Jacob is definitely an asset for the Cote’s Heating & AC Co. !! Thank you Jacob!!

Amazing company.  Friendly techs come same day even weekends. Not pushy. Fixed my old system.  Later installed a new system. Moved it into the attic with all new ductwork. House cools better and my allergies improved. Plus it's a family business. Thank y'all so much 💓

My tech was professional, thorough in his diagnostic and explained what needed to be fixed, after my AC was already up and running. Definitely was a trustworthy experience and as my tech modeled how to keep my AC and MiniSplit systems clean …

So about a week ago our AC stopped working. My wife was sick and needed the ac!   Very next day Jacob showed up.  Great guy. Knew what he was doing.

10/14/25.  Dylan Tekell came out to do our fall service.  Great guy. Was great service.

12-3-25. Once again Jacob to the rescue. This time new ductwork.  Besides being a complete pro at his work Jacob is a great guy.

Y’all can’t go wrong with Cote’s Mechanical!

If you need your AC fixed they are great!

I needed Service on my A/C system and Cote's sent over Jacob M. who was quick, detailed and professional. He inspected the entire system until he found the actual problem and repaired. I appreciated the way he explained the problem in detail and was quick to get it resolved and the A/C was pumping cold again. Highly recommend Cote's and make sure you ask them to send Jacob!

In 2022, I hired Cote’s Mechanical to help resolve cooling issues in my home. The owner at the time, Cote Wyatt, told me that my A/C unit was a 4-ton system and too small for the house. Based on his recommendation, I paid $4,400 to install a ductless mini split on the second floor and re-zone my master bedroom.

I recently discovered that my existing A/C unit is actually a 5-ton system, which is properly sized. The real cause of the cooling issues was a piston that was never replaced when the ev

Jacob Morris performed our winter service system maintenance and we are very pleased with his knowledge, thoroughness, and politeness.  He is a professional and we will request him in the future.  Thanks for the good service!

Zach Morgan came out to investigate a start up noise with the AC unit.  He was friendly & knowledgeable and installed a soft start kit. AC start up is very quiet now, plus surge protection.    Unrelated to the service call, he connected the thermostats to my Home app.  Thank you Zach, job well done!

CADE was my tech that came to my house for my maintenance. He went above and beyond- at least in comparison what everybody else has done in the past. I felt comfortable with his recommendations, he left everything very clean, explained everything thoroughly and was an absolute professional. If I could give him 10 Stars I would but Google only allows five. He's the only person I want to come do my maintenance.

Cody has been out to our house several times since we started using Cote’s Air Conditioning Mechanical. We want to recognize his knowledge & outstanding service that he provides.
Cody is an asset to your company!
Dylan was great! He fixed our unit in under an hour and we didn’t have to stay the night in a hot house. I was extremely impressed with his customer service expertise. I’d choose Cotes again any day.

Our A/C went out Thursday (very hot) evening and my husband called Friday morning. We were not looking forward to trying to sleep in  really hot conditions.  Your service tech Houston made it to our home by 5 pm and by 6 our A/C was back on line.  We are so grateful and pleased considering the 100+ temp the last few days. Professional, prompt, courteous and definitely on time.  Thank you so much for getting us back to the cool zone.  We even signed up for your yearly maintenance deal to keep our

My husband chose this company because it’s local. He signed up for their maintenance plan and had a good spring visit. Unfortunately, the tech who came out for the fall visit insisted that we needed to spend $7100 to replace 1 of the units’ coils. He noted that to my husband that he makes a lot of money on “leaky Lennox’s”, that we had mold throughout the system and advised that we buy UV lighting. There were other items that he recommended to include replacing the entire system (installed in 20
Dylan was our tech today. He was very friendly. Provided exceptional service and detail information. Very professional & respectful. Definitely 5 Star service! My Mom Donna R. and I very satisfied!!

If I could give Zach and Cote's more than 5 stars I would. Zach was prompt, courteous and explained the issues in detail. He went above and beyond finding  and fixing the issues I had.  Cote's is the only place I will use for both maintenance and repair.

We have used Cote’s for quite sometime now. I called Cote’s on Friday about a small issue (didn’t want it to turn into a big issue) so they sent Dylan out on Monday. Not only did Dylan figure out my issue, do my normal maintenance but he took the time and patience to do the work. Dylan is a great asset to Cote’s team.

I’ve been using Cote’s for over 10 years for my AC needs. They are always quick to respond (I live in Denton). They have always found a solution to any concern that I have! I really love using a family owned business that really care for their clients.

Dylan was great and fully explained the issue, got parts ordered and told us he will be back.  Thank you Dylan.

Now your AI phone answering will make me change to someone else real quick.  I am not a computer thus do not intend to be treated as such.  If I cannot talk to a human well your call!  Others have left you for the same reason.

We’ve been with Corw’s for a long time and always have a great technician. Their response time is remarkable. Andy was out this time with options for us to make our system run better, and just ideas on how to cool one room better. Great guy and a great company!

Dylan was fantastic, very efficient and knowledgeable.  He went above and beyond to get the nasty coils cleaned, sealed the closet the unit is in and made sure things were 100% before he left. Highly recommend

Excellent service! I highly recommend Cote’s for installation, yearly service and inspection on existing units. Especially important when a buyer is looking to buy an existing home. As a previous Realtor and Home Warranty rep, I told buyers to have the HVAC units inspected by a licensed HVAC company during the inspection period. It served as a way to show a unit was in good working condition at the time of inspection for the future proof to a home warranty company and if there were any prior iss
What a difference a good company can make. Cote's Mechanical has an outstanding tech. After listening to my tail of 😞   he listened. We can fix that , we guarantee our work! …
Eli was very courteous and was on time. He did an excellent job. We appreciate his skills.

Our air conditioner quit working the hottest month of the year. We thought for sure we’d have to wait a few days to get it fixed. Cote’s sent someone out the SAME DAY! Jacob M. showed up and immediately diagnosed the problem (bad compressor) and was able to replace the compressor before he left! Thank goodness for Jacob and Cote’s—we don’t have to sleep in a hot house tonight!
Dylan repaired our A/C quickly and efficiently. He explained everything so we could understand what the problem was. I was quite happy and would definitely use Cotes again.

This company just estimated me over $1,700 to install a simple appliance outlet, which is triple the amount of the highest of 3 other estimates I received for the same job. This company is criminal, do not give them your business!

Edit: after the owner left a response to this review, they messaged me for my email address so they could send me an invoice for the over the phone estimate that nobody even showed up for that they themselves told me would be a free estimate. This company is beyond ri
Best tech ever. Dylan took my relic of an ac system and got me all fixed up. Quick service and fair prices. I highly recommend Dylan and Cote's Mechanical!

I like to thank Dylan Tekell for being very professional and knowledgeable about his job. I believe he sets the standard of Cote's the best Heating & Air Conditioning company in North Texas. Thanks again Dylan for being so professional and a servant of God.

After a frustrating week without air conditioning, Cade came out and saved the day. He was able to use his experience to troubleshoot an issue that other technicians could not figure out. We are so appreciative for his help. He even worked until almost 930 at night to solve the issue

Excellent service was provided. I called and they came out the same day. I want to especially think the technician Cade, that has been out a couple of times to our house. He has excellent work ethic. He explains everything very well. Very kind and well mannered gentleman. Thanks for your hard work!
Always have had a great experience when Cotes comes to my house.  Dylan took it to another level with his thoroughness when performing our summer maintenance.  Thank you Dylan !

I’ve been using Coties Machanical for my HVAC the past nine years. I have always had professional and courteous service. The gentleman who came to my home this year (Dylan) was exceptional. He was courteous and explained what He would be doing and answered all my questions.
Cade came out, on time, and was wonderful. Very friendly and knowledgeable. He explained what he was doing every step of the way. He went above and beyond to make sure we were satisfied.

Dylan was so conscientious and friendly!  He took care of everything that needed to be done!  It was so reassuring, we didn’t have to try to figure anything out and it was all taken care of! Thank you so much Dylan!
Zach was timely and very professional. Repaired our issue and found some potential problems that we need to consider in the future. Explained the Shield Membership very well. Thanks Zach and Cote’s!

Today I had Zach M. He was awesome. Showed up in a timely fashion. He was very professional and was very knowledgeable about the problems that he addressed with my AC thermostat and unit. I have always been happy with the service I have received from Cote’s mechanical.

Adam was very knowledgeable and was able to diagnose and make the repair quickly. I highly recommend this company if you’re having AC issues. They answered the phone immediately (which is an issue nowadays with many businesses) and scheduled me for service right away. I found out they’re a family business, which is probably why they’re so efficient- they actually care about customers!

New review:
Dylan was our tech that came out for our regular maintenance checkup and found a sensor throwing errors that we did not notice. Very impressed with his knowledge and explanation of the sensor and system.
I'm grateful he found it and repaired/replaced under our warranty - the bad sensor wouldn't cause any immediate problems, but may not allow the system to run as efficiently as ideal, which would cause unnecessary wear on our compressor.
Again, very happy with Cote's and our tech Dyla
If you need an AC guy, Dylan is the one to ask for! Super friendly, explained everything clearly, and made the whole process easy. Definitely my go-to from now on.
Dylan was great to work with, knowledgeable, entertaining. Fixed the issue on the first try.  Thank you cotes for always sending competent  and enjoyable people to my home.
My service advisor Eli was the best! He was so friendly and explained everything he was doing. I appreciate his professionalism!

The sales and install teams were very friendly, courteous, and efficient during the initial meeting and install of our new unit. The install team rank high as one of the nicest crews I have ever had in my home. There was damage to my home when someone from the install team accidentally stepped through my ceiling which resulted in a very large hole in my ceiling and damage in another area of the house.
